diskGuard.limitation: polling guard with 256 MiB headroom, not a filesystem hard quota; du/exec can perturb throughput
diskGuard.phaseCostScope: host-observed client checkpoint phases; wall costs are not CPU time and are never subtracted from TPS
diskGuard.budgetScope: one disposable 600-second run; 8 GiB host reserve unchanged
diskGuard.allocationMethod: du -sk allocated 1 KiB blocks from this project's three node roots

serviceBoundary.scope: same-node service thread checkpoint; includes bounded final-state CAPTURE and boundary-control costs; not pure domain CPU
serviceBoundary.clock: node-local System.nanoTime; never subtract another JVM clock

metrics.scope: cumulative operational meters; external observation, outside financial state
metrics.maxSemantics: Micrometer timer window maximum; do not subtract checkpoints

markerSender.scope: cumulative test marker sender; every marker delivered, timing sampled every 256 offers

before.scope: cumulative client collector; all frames correlated; lock timing sampled every 256 acquired operations; empty completion polls excluded

after.scope: cumulative client collector; all frames correlated; lock timing sampled every 256 acquired operations; empty completion polls excluded

gateDwell.scope: sum of disjoint observed gate-mask dwell inside each offering window; phase preparation, aggregation and drain gaps excluded

measurement.throughputSemantics: 600-second wall window begins before sample allocation; includes all phase preparation, histogram aggregation, drain gaps and final ACK
measurement.rawSpanSemantics: first send attempt -> last correlated observation; excludes remaining offering-window time

serviceInterval.scope: same-node checkpoint deltas after all-node ACK-floor verification; service CPU/allocation include final CAPTURE and boundary-control costs, not pure domain CPU
serviceInterval.maxSemantics: no interval maximum derived from cumulative checkpoints

collectorInterval.maxSemantics: no maximum derived from cumulative checkpoints

limitation: duration window with explicit finite sample budget; partial makers retained; same-host Docker CPU/IO; not absolute maximum sustainable TPS or remote disaster RPO0
